steps.action: Turn on Single sign-on (SSO) under Legal User Authentication; an invited staff account signs in through the identity provider
steps.expected: Callback succeeds; role Legal team member retained; row becomes Active
steps.actual: The switch saved ("Saved"). In a separate browser, Continue with single sign-on went through the fixture's authorize endpoint and the OpenLaw callback to /, signed in as legal_team_member. The invited row now read Active with a role control (true).

steps.action: An uninvited identity on a matching email domain gets no staff role
steps.expected: No staff session; no staff account
steps.actual: With Business Portal single sign-on off, doc029-auth-uninvited-mu49nedl@helix.example (matching the provider's helix.example domain, not an allowed Portal domain) ended on /auth/login?error=sso with me 401 and "Single sign-on failed. Try again.". Account created: none.

steps.action: Save provider with Client secret left blank, then with a replacement secret; test a fresh sign-in after each
steps.expected: Saved both times; staff SSO still works
steps.actual: The Client secret hint read "Leave blank to keep the current secret. Paste a new value to rotate." Saving a Client ID change with a blank secret showed Saved; a fresh staff SSO sign-in worked (me 200). Saving a replacement secret showed Saved; another fresh sign-in worked (me 200). Stored client ID: doc029-client-mu49nedl.

steps.action: Update the issuer to one that cannot be reached
steps.expected: Refused; the previous provider stays usable
steps.actual: Save provider with an unreachable issuer showed "The change could not be saved. Try again.". The stored issuer stayed http://oidc:8080 and a fresh staff SSO sign-in still worked (me 200).

steps.action: Turn on Single sign-on (SSO) under Business Portal Authentication; an existing Business User signs in through the identity provider
steps.expected: Existing Business User enters the Portal; no staff role is granted to any identity
steps.actual: Check failed: existing {"path":"/portal/login?error=sso","me":401,"role":null,"alert":["Single sign-on failed. Try again."]}

steps.action: Recover: Administrator password sign-in with Email and password off under Legal, then turn on Email and password and turn off SSO
steps.expected: Admin password sign-in works; staff login returns to password; SSO off
steps.actual: With only Single sign-on (SSO) on for Legal users ({"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false}), the Administrator still signed in with a password (me 200). Turning Email and password and Email magic link back on and SSO off in both cards gave {"legal":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false},"business":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}}, and the Legal Team Member signed in with a password again (me 200).
